items.t: Has NIKE (NKE) Fallen Far Enough to Look Undervalued?
items.sum: NIKE has seen a deep share price reset over the last few years, which puts fresh attention on whether the cash the business can generate really supports where the stock trades today. After a long run as a consumer icon, the question for investors is no longer about brand strength, but about what the current price implies for future cash flows. Over the past 5 years the share price has fallen 76.8%
